mapIdentity.scope: The named current map outline puts the cinema and its later service wing on Donald Street. The forward center of the footprint aligns with the historic marquee and entry rather than an upper-volume projection.

note: The matched 1919 Howard Crane rendering establishes the seven fluted-pilaster bays with arched fanlights and faux balconies. Parks Canada and Winnipeg’s municipal heritage survey describe the terra cotta garlands, heavy cornice and brick parapet. The venue and architect record the present canopy and service wing.
